acceptance_criteria: Both fixed-denominator limit claims map exactly once to a finite rational-approximant diagnostic.
The clean-room runner reads only frozen config and independent Harper-equation code.
Finite convergence diagnostics cannot promote the uncountability, Cantor topology, zero-measure, or continuity theorems to accepted scientific coverage.
The six displayed figures and their supporting executable checks are generated from the printed equations without author code, author arrays, digitized curves, or source pixels.
Every reduced rational flux p/q produces exactly q bands, all band edges satisfy the independent transfer-trace condition, and the flux/energy symmetries and [-4,4] bound pass.
The three Fig. 6 eigenvalues agree with the printed values within their printed precision and every generated eigenvector passes a direct residual check.
Scientific arrays are hash-frozen before any source figure is exposed to the renderer; reconstructed sampling choices remain explicitly distinct from paper-exact parameters.
